data.name: Zonovia
data.gender_notes: Zonovia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Zion', meaning 'fortress' or 'highest point'. In Greek mythology, Zeus is the king of the gods and god of the sky, weather, thunder, lightning, law, order, and justice. 'Zonovia' can be interpreted as 'Grace of Zeus' or 'Grace of God'. The name Zonovia carries the meaning “Grace of Zeus” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Zonovia usually hope their child will grow to embody grace of zeus and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, power, and divine protection.
data.etymology: Zonovia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace of Zeus.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zonovia total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: זונוביה
in_hebrew.meaning: זונוביה היא שם שפירושו חוכמת אלוהים או חוכמת שמים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: זונוביה היא שם שמקורו במילים העבריות 'זונו' שפירושו חוכמה או תבונה, ו'אלוהים' או 'שמים' שפירושו אלוהים או שמים. היא מייצגת את החוכמה האלוהית ואת הקשר עם השמימי. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים ומשקף את הערכים הרוחניים והמוסריים של האמונה הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Ζωνοβία
in_greek.meaning: Ζωνοβία σημαίνει σοφία του Θεού ή ουράνια σοφία
in_greek.long_meaning: Ζωνοβία είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'ζώνω' που σημαίνει ζω ή ευημερώ και 'βία' που σημαίνει δύναμη ή σοφία. Το όνομα συνδέεται με την έννοια της σοφίας του Θεού και της πνευματικής δύναμης. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Ζωνοβία αντανακλά την πνευματική ανάπτυξη και την ηθική ωριμότητα.

in_latin.name: Zonovia
in_latin.meaning: Zonovia significat sapientia Dei seu caelestis sapientia
in_latin.long_meaning: Zonovia est nomen quod ex latinizatione vocabulorum hebraicorum vel graecorum oritur, significans sapientiam divinam vel caelestem. Nomen hoc in traditione christiana adhibetur ut significet sapientiam et prudentiam quae a Deo procedunt. Est nomen quod virtutes morales et spirituales repraesentat.

historical_references.reference: The legend of St. Zonovia, a Syrian princess who became a martyr in the 3rd century AD, states that she was the daughter of King Herodian of Antioch. Zonovia was renowned for her beauty and virtue, and attracted the attention of the Roman prefect, Maximian, who demanded her hand in marriage. When she refused, Maximian ordered her to be tortured and executed. Her body was buried in the city of Apamea, and her tomb became a popular pilgrimage site.

Another tradition identifies St. Zonovia as a Roman noblewoman who lived during the persecution of Diocletian in the late 3rd and early 4th centuries AD. According to this account, Zonovia was a devoted Christian and refused to offer sacrifice to the Roman gods. She was arrested, tortured, and eventually beheaded. Her relics were taken to Genoa, Italy, where they are still venerated in the Basilica of Santa Maria Assunta.

On social media platforms such as TikTok and Instagram, users create content centered around goddess worship and manifestation practices using the name Zonovia. Additionally, on Etsy and other handmade marketplaces, you can find various products named after Zonovia, such as jewelry, candles, and artwork, which reflect the goddess' association with feminine energy and spirituality.
